description: Returns companies ranked by factor scores: return on equity, gross, operating and net margin, revenue growth, free cash flow to assets, debt to equity, asset turnover, current ratio and Piotroski F-score, each with a percentile rank from 0 (worst) to 1 (best), plus a composite rank. Use this when the user wants companies ranked or filtered by quality or growth, or where one company ranks. It covers current and former S&P 500 companies; one company's ratios over time come from `get_financial_ratios`.

as_of_date.description: Point-in-time cutoff, YYYY-MM-DD: each company ranked on what it had filed by this date, e.g. 2024-06-30.

exclude_outliers.description: true also drops rows with implausible factor values, such as near-zero denominators; defaults to false, e.g. true.

limit.description: Number of companies to return, 1 to 100; defaults to 25, e.g. 10.

offset.description: Rows to skip from the top of the limit results; defaults to 0, e.g. 10.

sector.description: Sector name to match, case-insensitive partial match, e.g. Technology.

sort_by.description: Rank to sort by, such as composite_rank (the default), roe_rank or piotroski_f_score_rank, e.g. roe_rank.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol or SEC CIK to show one company's scores; omit to rank all companies, e.g. AAPL.

name: screen_universe

_meta.description: Provenance envelope — data lineage for every MCP response

data_quality.description: Server-side invariants run on this response

fundamentals_as_of.description: Use THIS — not `last_updated` — when telling a user how current the cross-sectional fundamentals are. The snapshot is republished on every weekday price refresh while the statements are carried forward unchanged, so `last_updated` can be far more recent than the numbers it sits next to. It is a floor for a single filer, not a ceiling: a filer with a live partition receives its filing, facts and ratios intraday (minutes after EDGAR dissemination), so an entity-scoped read may carry a filing newer than this; cross-sectional ranks (factor scores, earnings signals) refresh with the weekly bulk export.

pit_safe.description: true iff a zero-look-ahead point-in-time cut was applied to every returned figure

price_as_of.description: ISO timestamp when the price surfaces were last refreshed.

truncation.description: Set when fewer rows were returned than requested — explains why and points to a remedy

as_of_date.description: Present only when a point-in-time as_of_date was supplied

data.description: Ranked factor-score rows for the screened universe

lineage.description: Provenance for pipeline-derived values (the ratio table / the factor_scores table): source table + pipeline computed_at, plus a pointer to the tools that return filing-level lineage. NOT point-in-time (recomputed on each pipeline run).

pit_safe.description: Present (and true) only when as_of_date was supplied — the screen was filtered by factor_scores.accepted_at with zero look-ahead

sector_filter.description: Present only when a sector filter was applied

ticker.description: Present only when a single-ticker lookup was requested

truncation.description: Present only when the inline-row cap withheld rows. Page with `next_offset` (keep the same `limit`) or pull the full set via get_compute_ready_stream.
